original.Body: Zachary did 35 push-ups and 3 crunches in gym class today. David did 58 more push-ups but 87 less crunches than zachary.
original.Question: How many more push-ups than crunches did Zachary do?

thoughts.current:
<Step 1> Find how many push-ups David did:

David did 35 + 58 = 93 push-ups.

<Step 2> Find how many crunches David did:

David did 3 - 87 = -84 crunches.

<Step 3> Find how many more push-ups than crunches Zachary did:

Zachary did 35 push-ups - 3 crunches = 32 more push-ups than crunches.

<Step 4> Add the additional push-ups David did to calculate how many more push-ups than crunches Zachary did:

32 + 58 = 90 more push-ups than crunches.

<Step 5> Answer: Zachary did 90 more push-ups than crunches.
